verdict.rationale: Lago ships in-product AI. A plain-language billing agent lets you manage billing by describing what you need (lago-docs-28). A Dunning Agent reads twelve months of invoices, payments, disputes and provider status before acting, then hands the rest to a person (lago-docs-10, lago-docs-25), which amounts to AI analysis of customer data. However, the evidence frames both as task automation rather than surfaced insights or suggestions, and the revenue analytics dashboards are not described as AI-driven (lago-docs-15). Missing for 10: explicit in-product AI insights or recommendations over billing or revenue data, AI-assisted analytics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agents.
